description:
[Deterministic EU AI Act Risk Tier classification. Pure statutory logic, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates an AI system under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act), auditing Prohibited Practices (Art. 5), High-Risk classifications (Annex III and safety components Annex I), Specific Transparency obligations (Art. 50), and General Purpose AI model tiers (GPAI 10^25 FLOPs).
Usage: Use this tool to establish official legal risk tier, statutory deadlines (2025/2026/2027), and mandatory compliance steps for AI systems.
Returns: JSON object with { legalRiskTier: string, prohibitedPracticeTriggered: boolean, highRiskCategory: string | null, transparencyObligations: array, gpaiStatus: object, statutoryDeadlines: array, complianceChecklist: array, legalCitation: string }.

generatesSyntheticMediaOrDeepfakes.description: Whether the system generates deepfakes or synthetic media (Art. 50(2))

gpaiTrainingComputeFlops.description: Cumulative training compute FLOPs (threshold: 10^25 FLOPs for systemic risk)

hasHumanInTheLoopOversight.description: Whether meaningful human oversight is configured (Art. 14)

isDirectInteractionWithHumans.description: Whether the system interacts directly with natural persons (Art. 50(1))

isSafetyComponentOfRegulatedProduct.description: Whether AI is a safety component of products in Annex I (medical devices, machinery, civil aviation)

systemName.description: Identifier or commercial name of the AI system

useCaseDomain.description: Operational functional domain under EU AI Act Regulation (EU) 2024/1689

name: ai_act_risk_tier_classifier
